title: Whakaora Kōnae
subtitle: Whakakotahihia ngā wāhanga i tiakina e ō kaitiaki.
page_description: I whiwhi ia kaitiaki i tētahi paihere me tētahi wāhanga o te kī. Kohia kia rahi ngā wāhanga ki raro nei, tāpirihia te pūranga whakamuna, ā, ka wetemunatia ō kōnae ki konei i te pūtirotiro. Kāore he mea e wehe atu i tō pūrere.
step1_drop: Tukuna ngā kōnae paihere ki konei, pāwhiria rānei ki te tirotiro
step2_drop: Tukuna he recover.html, he MANIFEST.age rānei ki konei, pāwhiria rānei ki te kōwhiri
step2_hint: Whakamahia he recover.html mai i te paihere a tētahi kaitiaki, te kōnae MANIFEST.age rānei
no_manifest: Kāore anō he pūranga kia tāpirihia

error_no_share_message: Kāore he wāhanga whakaora kei roto i te kōnae "{0}".

error_mismatch_message: Ehara tēnei wāhanga i te huinga kotahi me ērā atu.
error_mismatch_guidance: I waihangatia ia wāhanga hei wāhi o tētahi huinga motuhake. Ka taea anake te whakakotahi i ngā wāhanga o te huinga kotahi. Tirohia i ahu mai ngā wāhanga katoa i ngā paihere a te tangata kotahi.
error_file_read_title: Kāore i taea te pānui i te kōnae
error_file_read_message: I rahua te pānui i te kōnae "{0}".
error_file_read_guidance: Tērā pea kua pirau te kōnae, kāore rānei e taea te uru. Tikiakehia anō, tonoa rānei tō kaitiaki kia tukuna anō tā rātou paihere.
error_bundle_extract_title: Kāore tēnei i te rite ki te paihere
error_bundle_extract_message: Kāore i taea te huaki i "{0}".
error_bundle_extract_guidance: Whakamahia te ZIP paihere taketake i tukuna ki a koe, ki tētahi rānei o ō kaitiaki.
error_unrecognized_file_title: Kāore i te mārama me aha tēnei

error_html_no_share_guidance: Kāore he wāhanga whakaora kei roto i tēnei recover.html. Tonoa tō kaitiaki kia tukuna anō tā rātou paihere, whakamahia rānei te kōnae README.txt.
error_paste_no_share_title: Kāore he wāhanga kei te kupu i whakapiria
error_paste_no_share_message: Kāore he wāhanga whakaora tika kei roto i te kupu i whakapiria.
error_paste_no_share_guidance: Tāruatia te ihirangi katoa mai i te README.txt a tētahi kaitiaki, me ngā tohu 'BEGIN REMEMORY SHARE' me 'END REMEMORY SHARE'. Ka taea hoki te pato, te whakapiri rānei i ngā kupu whakaora.
error_decrypt_message: Kāore i taea te wetemuna i te pūranga ki ngā wāhanga i homai.
error_decrypt_guidance: Tirohia nō te huinga kotahi ngā wāhanga katoa. Mēnā he wāhanga tāpiri āu, whakamātauria tētahi huinga rerekē.
error_decrypt_status: I rahua te wetemuna. Tirohia ō wāhanga, ka ngana anō.
error_extract_title: I rahua te tango i te pūranga
error_extract_message: Kāore i taea te huaki i te pūranga kua wetemunatia.
error_extract_guidance: Tērā pea kua pirau te pūranga. Mēnā he kape anō tō MANIFEST.age, whakamātauria tērā.
error_extract_status: I rahua te tango. Tērā pea kua pirau te pūranga.
error_recovery_guidance: Tirohia kei a koe ngā wāhanga tika me te kōnae MANIFEST.age tika. Ka taea te ngana anō ki ētahi wāhanga rerekē.
error_corrupt_embedded_manifest_message: Kua pirau te pūranga kei roto i tēnei recover.html, kāore i taea te uta.
error_corrupt_embedded_manifest_guidance: Tērā pea kua poroa, kua pirau rānei tō kape o recover.html. Whakamātauria tētahi atu kape, utaina rānei a MANIFEST.age ā-ringa i te Hipanga 2.
error_preloaded_share_title: Kāore i taea te uta i tō wāhanga
error_preloaded_share_message: Kāore i taea te pānui i te wāhanga kei roto i tēnei recover.html.
error_preloaded_share_guidance: Ka taea tonu te tāpiri wāhanga mā te tuku i te README.txt a tētahi kaitiaki ki raro nei, mā te whakapiri rānei.
